reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND p.unit_cost_eur < (
    SELECT AVG(p2.unit_cost_eur)
    FROM products p2
    JOIN categories c2 ON c2.category_id = p2.category_id
    WHERE c2.parent_category = 'Audio'
  )
alternatives:
WITH audio AS (
  -- one row per Audio product
  SELECT p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur
  FROM products p
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'
)
SELECT product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM audio
WHERE unit_cost_eur < (SELECT AVG(unit_cost_eur) FROM audio)

SELECT product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE parent_category = 'Audio')
  AND unit_cost_eur < (
    SELECT AVG(unit_cost_eur)
    FROM products
    WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE parent_category = 'Audio')
  )
